subject: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing
messages:
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@clearriver.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for committing to the integration call last week. As a next step our procurement team needs to capture banking and invoicing preferences so we can complete vendor setup and issue the first PO. Quick checklist items we need from ClearRiver to avoid delays: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached)
- W-9 or equivalent tax document (US vendors)
- Bank authorization / ACH enrollment form (for push payments)
- Confirm preferred payment method: ACH (domestic) vs wire (international)
- Primary remittance email address to send remittance advices
- Invoice submission method: emailed PDF, dedicated portal upload, or SFTP?
- PO number formatting: do you require the PO on the invoice header or in the invoice footnote?

Our default payment terms are net 30 from invoice receipt, and we always include a PO when purchasing. If you have any constraints (e.g., wire fees, intermediary banks, or required references on the remittance), please flag them now.

Attaching: redwood_vendor_onboarding_request.pdf (fill & return).

If easier, reply inline with the items above and include any attachments. Once we have the W-9 and bank auth, I will loop in Finance (Laura) to complete the vendor record and issue the PO.

Thanks —
Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@clearriver.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: payables@clearriver.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing

Hi Rohan —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Please find answers below and attached docs.

- Vendor documents attached: CRS_W-9.pdf, CRS_bank_authorization.pdf
- Preferred payment method: ACH for all USD payments. For payments originating outside the US we prefer wire.
- Bank details: See bank auth (account and routing). We can provide beneficiary name + account number on the bank auth form.
- Remittance: please send remittance advices to billing@clearriver.com. Our AP team monitors that inbox and will reconcile.
- Invoice submission: primary method is emailed PDF to billing@clearriver.com. We also have a supplier portal (https://portal.clearriver.com/payables) if you want automated ingestion — portal invoices map automatically to PO numbers.
- PO visibility: Please include the PO number in the invoice header (upper right). We require a PO to be present and a unique invoice number.
- Wire/ACH fees: ClearRiver absorbs bank fees on ACH. For international wires, we request the invoice amount and note if costs are to be split. If Redwood requires intermediary bank details, we will provide them on request.

Attached: CRS_W-9.pdf, CRS_bank_authorization.pdf

Let me know if you need any additional forms. If Finance wants to run a test ACH, we can authorize a micro-deposit verification.

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Finance Operations
ClearRiver Supplies

From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@clearriver.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Dec 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing

Laura —

Forwarding ClearRiver's responses and attachments. They prefer ACH for USD, email invoicing to billing@clearriver.com, and want the PO number in the invoice header. They attached W-9 and bank auth.

Can Finance confirm: 
1) Ok to set them up for ACH and schedule our initial verification (micro-deposit) or do we prefer a one-time test?
2) Do we need any additional vendor checklist items (insurance, POC for tax docs)?
3) If we proceed, what is the expected timeline for issuing the first PO?

If any approvals are needed for non-standard terms (e.g., net 45), flag them here.

Thanks —
Rohan

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena@clearriver.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing

Hi all —

Thanks, Elena — the W-9 and bank auth look complete. Quick finance notes: 

- We will set ClearRiver up in the vendor master once we receive the signed bank auth and completed onboarding form (Rohan's attached PDF).
- Redwood standard terms are Net 30. We can consider Net 45 for the first two invoices if necessary but that requires approval from Accounting; please advise if you require Net 45 as a hard condition.
- We will issue the PO within 48 business hours of vendor record creation and expect the first payment run on our next cycle (Net 30).
- For ACH verification: we'll do micro-deposits (two small amounts) to the provided account and confirm back to billing@clearriver.com. Please confirm you will monitor that inbox.
- Remittance format: our AP system prefers a CSV remittance file via email (same billing@clearriver.com) with columns: PO, invoice_number, amount, payment_date. If you require an EDI/other format, let us know and we can evaluate.

Action items: 
- Elena: confirm billing@clearriver.com will accept micro-deposit confirmations and CSV remittances (reply OK).
- Elena: if Net 45 is a strict requirement, please confirm and provide justification.
- Rohan: once vendor form is returned, I will begin vendor master entry and alert when PO is created.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@clearriver.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Payment onboarding: ACH vs wire, remittance & PO routing

Hi Laura —

OK to all items: billing@clearriver.com will monitor micro-deposit verification and accept CSV remittances via email in the layout you specified. Net 30 is acceptable; Net 45 is not required. We can proceed with standard Net 30 terms.

I'll keep an eye out for the micro-deposit and for the PO. If you want us to confirm receipt of the first payment, reply and we will send acknowledgement.

Thanks,
Elena
